# Catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

Every public name with a one-line description, by application. Each name links to its entry in the [API reference](../api/index.md), which gives the signature and every parameter.

- [Core library](core.md): The framework every application builds on: the network, the layers (including the flow allocation layer), the model, the set-up helpers, and the general-purpose constitutive laws and heads.
- [Building physics](building_physics.md): Multi-zone airflow, heat and contaminants (CONTAM's physics; CONTAM `.prj`/`.wth`, EPW and Modelica Buildings Library readers). The airflow constitutive laws and heads a building uses come from the core library and are listed here too.
- [Street air quality](street_aq.md): Street-canyon networks: canyon exchange, junction routing, above-roof plumes, chemistry and exposure (SIRANE and MUNICH physics, case readers and writers).
- [Sewers](sewer.md): Gravity sewers: hydraulics, headspace air and sulfide (SWMM `.inp` reader).
- [Water distribution](water.md): Pressurised water networks: pipes, pumps, valves, tanks and demand (EPANET `.inp` reader).
- [WSIMOD](wsimod.md): WSIMOD 0.8.1's daily step, transcribed: a WSIMOD `config.yml` as a noodl `Model` whose closure runs WSIMOD's day bitwise, batched and differentiable.
- [Electrical circuits](electrical.md): Electrical circuits: resistors, capacitors, inductors, sources and their waveforms, diodes, switches, transformers and controlled sources (Modelica Standard Library device laws); impedances, constant-power loads and power converters (Modelica Buildings Library laws); Joule heating into a thermal network; the reader of OpenModelica circuit exports; balanced AC and DC power flow in per unit (MATPOWER branch model, shunts, voltage-controlled generators) and the MATPOWER case-file reader.
